## Mobile

Expo config plugin props (`app.json` › `plugins` › `["@clikgate/react-native", {…}]`): `linkDomains` (live domains: the app link subdomain and custom domains, never a shared domain), `testLinkDomain` (the app test subdomain, e.g. `"yourapp.dev.ciz.to"`), `testVariants` (default `["development", "preview"]`), `uriScheme`, `enableBackgroundRemoteNotifications`, `enableWhatsAppSharing`.

## Web

### Web script: `https://sdk.clikgate.com/v1/static/clikgate.js`

Script tag attributes: `data-param` (default `cgid`), `data-days` (default `7`), `data-consent`, `data-web-key`, `data-api`, `data-clikgate-payments`.

```js
Clikgate.attachToForms(selector)
Clikgate.clickId()
Clikgate.conversionMetadata()
Clikgate.gaClientId()
Clikgate.getClickId()
Clikgate.getConsent()
Clikgate.goal(goal, o)
Clikgate.identifyUser(o)
Clikgate.paymentMetadata()
Clikgate.setConsent(values)
Clikgate.setConsentRegion(region)
Clikgate.share.mount(element, o)
```

Constants: `Clikgate.GoalStatus` (`COUNTED`, `WAITING`, `REFUSED`); `Clikgate.Provider` (`PAYSTACK`, `FLUTTERWAVE`, `MONNIFY`, …, `CUSTOM`). `Clikgate.goal(key, {reference, provider, value, currency, isFirst})` returns a promise of `{status, reason}`.

## Server

### Node.js: `@clikgate/node` 1.1.0

`import { Clikgate, webhooks } from '@clikgate/node';` Add-ons: `@clikgate/node/express` (`clikgateMiddleware`), `@clikgate/node/fastify` (`clikgatePlugin`), `@clikgate/node/next` (`applyClikgate`, `createClikgateProxy`, `clikgateProxy`, `clikgateMiddleware`, `getClickId`, `keepRoute`).

```ts
}

```

Webhooks: `webhooks.verify(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret, { tolerance? })` and `webhooks.verifyAny(rawBody, signatureHeader, secrets[], { tolerance? })`. No client or API key is needed.

Enums (constants and types, `import { GoalKind, GoalStatus, Provider } from '@clikgate/node';`): `GoalKind` (`GoalKind.Standard`, `GoalKind.Payment`); `GoalStatus` (`GoalStatus.Counted`, `GoalStatus.Waiting`, `GoalStatus.Refused`, `GoalStatus.Received`); `Provider` (`Provider.Paystack`, `Provider.Flutterwave`, `Provider.Monnify`, …, `Provider.Custom`). `Provider` lists every gateway; a provider key string works too.

Python (`clikgate`), PHP (`clikgate/clikgate-php`), Java (`com.clikgate:clikgate-java`) and .NET (`Clikgate`) are **not available yet**. Use the HTTP API in [server-sdks.md](server-sdks.md).
